preregistered_result.reason: one release-policy critique scored 0.75 deterministic defect-area recall

related_findings.evidence: release_policy.py:16-18 uses roots and change["path"] without validation. A missing path raises KeyError, and an empty root matches every path.
related_findings.summary: Paths and roots are not validated as non-empty normalized relative POSIX paths; malformed values can also raise instead of failing closed.

related_findings.evidence: release_policy.py:17-19 reads only change["path"]; a record with path "release/file", an out-of-scope rename source, or an unknown action can return true.
related_findings.summary: Rename sources and actions are ignored, allowing an out-of-scope source or unknown action to pass.

post_hoc_scorer_audit.interpretation: The missed area retained its x5 claim citation and described the malformed and unknown-action behaviors, but no single finding used one frozen second-group lexical term. This is evidence for a structured claim-coverage contract, not grounds to override the preregistered failure.

next_gate: Test a result contract that requires one explicit assessment for every capsule claim before spending more calls on batch-size confirmation.
